lines.text: Wait! Why Seeing Someone Yawn Makes YOU Yawn Too!
Most kids guess totally wrong about why is yawning contagious!
Stop and picture what actually happens inside.
Yawning boosts alertness and helps regulate brain temperature,.
while social mirror neurons trigger contagious yawns across groups.
Nature uses amazing science tricks right under our noses!
Even many grown-ups still believe the old rumor instead of this fact!
Now you know the real truth behind Yawn Chain!
Share this trick with a friend and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
